attchmntText: Maithan Alloys Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition of Equity Shares through Stock Exchange.
voiceSummary: Maithan Alloys Limited acquired 48,901 shares, representing 0.04% of ESDS Software Solution Limited, on 11th November 2026. The acquisition was completed through the stock exchange for a total cash consideration of Rs. 5.89 Crore. The event occurred at 3:30 P.M. on 11th November 2026. Maithan Alloys Limited does not intend to acquire control of the target entity. The acquisition is classified as an arms-length transaction and is not a related party transaction. ESDS Software Solution Limited is an IT-enabled services provider with a turnover of Rs. 378 Crore for the financial year ending 31st March 2026. The company acquired the shares for long-term or short-term investment benefits. No governmental or regulatory approvals were required for this transaction.

attchmntText: Maithan Alloys Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP
Maithan Alloys Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of Mr Palghat Krishnan Venkatramani as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. November 09, 2026.
voiceSummary: Maithan Alloys Limited announces that Mr. Palghat Krishnan Venkatramani, DIN 05303022, has resigned as an Independent Director and from the Audit, Nomination and Remuneration, Corporate Social Responsibility, and Risk Management Committees. The resignation is effective from the close of business hours on 9th November 2026, upon the completion of his second term. Mr. Venkatramani was initially re-appointed on 10th November 2021 for a period of 5 years. He confirmed there are no material reasons for his resignation other than the conclusion of his tenure. He does not hold directorships in any other listed entities. The company confirms no other material reasons exist for the resignation. This information is submitted pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.
